#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Append a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to the given pptx."""
import os, re, sys, zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

SRC = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
TEXT = "Thank you for your attention"
if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    sys.exit(f"error: {SRC} not found")

P = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main"
R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
A = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"
SLIDE_CT = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
names = set(zin.namelist())
nums = sorted(int(m.group(1)) for n in names if (m := re.match(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", n)))
slide_num = max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

pres = zin.read("ppt/presentation.xml").decode("utf-8")
presrels = zin.read("ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
ct = zin.read("[Content_Types].xml").decode("utf-8")

ids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'<p:sldId\b[^>]*\bid="(\d+)"', pres)]
rids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'\bId="rId(\d+)"', presrels)]
new_id = max(ids) + 1 if ids else 256
rel_id = f"rId{max(rids) + 1}" if rids else "rId1"
n_before = len(ids)

sz = re.search(r'<p:sldSz\b[^>]*\bcx="(\d+)"[^>]*\bcy="(\d+)"', pres)
cx, cy = (int(sz.group(1)), int(sz.group(2))) if sz else (12192000, 6858000)

entry = f'<p:sldId id="{new_id}" r:id="{rel_id}"/>'
lst = re.search(r"<p:sldIdLst>.*?</p:sldIdLst>", pres, re.S)
if lst:
    at = lst.end() - len("</p:sldIdLst>")
    pres = pres[:at] + entry + pres[at:]
else:
    pres = pres.replace("</p:sld>", f"<p:sldIdLst>{entry}</p:sldIdLst></p:sld>", 1)

presrels = presrels.replace(
    "</Relationships>",
    f'<Relationship Id="{rel_id}" Type="{R}/slide" Target="slides/slide{slide_num}.xml"/></Relationships>', 1)
ct = ct.replace(
    "</Types>",
    f'<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide{slide_num}.xml" ContentType="{SLIDE_CT}"/></Types>', 1)

layout_target = None
if nums:
    last_rels = f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{max(nums)}.xml.rels"
    if last_rels in names:
        m = re.search(r'Type="[^"]*slideLayout"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"',
                      zin.read(last_rels).decode("utf-8"))
        layout_target = m.group(1) if m else None
if layout_target is None:
    layouts = sorted(n for n in names if re.match(r"ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout\d+\.xml$", n))
    if layouts:
        layout_target = "../slideLayouts/" + layouts[0].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]

x, w = int(cx * 0.08), int(cx * 0.84)
y, h = int(cy * 0.40), int(cy * 0.20)
slide_xml = f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<p:sld xmlns:a="{A}" xmlns:r="{R}" xmlns:p="{P}">
  <p:cSld>
    <p:spTree>
      <p:nvGrpSpPr><p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/><p:cNvGrpSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvGrpSpPr>
      <p:grpSpPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/><a:chOff x="0" y="0"/><a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/></a:xfrm></p:grpSpPr>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYouText"/><p:cNvSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:xfrm><a:off x="{x}" y="{y}"/><a:ext cx="{w}" cy="{h}"/></a:xfrm>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr wrap="square" anchor="ctr"><a:normAutofit/></a:bodyPr>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p>
            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>
            <a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="3600" b="1"/><a:t>{TEXT}</a:t></a:r>
            <a:endParaRPr lang="en-US"/>
          </a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
    </p:spTree>
  </p:cSld>
  <p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr>
</p:sld>'''
rels_xml = None
if layout_target:
    rels_xml = f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="{R}/slideLayout" Target="{layout_target}"/>
</Relationships>'''

tmp = SRC + ".new"
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == "ppt/presentation.xml":
            data = pres.encode("utf-8")
        elif item.filename == "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels":
            data = presrels.encode("utf-8")
        elif item.filename == "[Content_Types].xml":
            data = ct.encode("utf-8")
        info = zipfile.ZipInfo(item.filename, date_time=item.date_time)
        info.compress_type = item.compress_type or zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        info.external_attr = item.external_attr
        zout.writestr(info, data)
    zout.writestr(f"ppt/slides/slide{slide_num}.xml", slide_xml.encode("utf-8"))
    if rels_xml:
        zout.writestr(f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{slide_num}.xml.rels", rels_xml.encode("utf-8"))
zin.close()
os.replace(tmp, SRC)

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    if z.testzip():
        sys.exit("error: output archive failed CRC check")
    for part in ("[Content_Types].xml", "ppt/presentation.xml", "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels",
                 f"ppt/slides/slide{slide_num}.xml"):
        ET.fromstring(z.read(part))
    n_after = len(re.findall(r"<p:sldId\b", z.read("ppt/presentation.xml").decode("utf-8")))
assert n_after == n_before + 1, "slide count mismatch"
print(f"added final slide {slide_num}: {TEXT!r} ({n_after} slides)")
